name: Exp_SlopeDirectionLine
summary: This EA trades based on the SlopeDirectionLine custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0). It uses a double-smoothing approach with configurable smoothing methods and manages both entry and exit signals independently with separate toggle switches.
summary_zh: 该EA基于SlopeDirectionLine自定义指标进行交易，当指标信号为上升趋势（值=2）时开多仓，当信号为下降趋势（值=0）时开空仓。它采用双平滑方法，支持配置平滑算法，并独立管理入场和出场信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于SlopeDirectionLine指标的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件：当指标缓冲区1的值从非2变为2时开多仓，从非0变为0时开空仓，这表示趋势方向发生转变。出场条件：当上升趋势信号出现时平空仓，当下降趋势信号出现时平多仓，实现了趋势反转时自动平仓。仓位管理方面，支持多种保证金模式（MMMode），包括基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。指标本身使用两层平滑算法，第一层对价格进行主要平滑（如LWMA），第二层对第一层结果再平滑（如SMA），从而产生更平滑的趋势判断线。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a trend-following system based on the SlopeDirectionLine indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 1 value changes from non-2 to 2 (uptrend onset), and a sell position opens when it changes from non-0 to 0 (downtrend onset), signaling trend direction changes. Exit conditions: existing sell positions close when an uptrend signal appears, and existing buy positions close when a downtrend signal appears, implementing automatic position closure on trend reversal. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes (MMMode) including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1, representing the risk fraction per trade. The indicator itself employs a dual-smoothing algorithm where the first layer applies primary smoothing to price data (e.g., LWMA) and the second layer further smooths the result (e.g., SMA), producing a smoother trend determination line.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 保证金模式（自由保证金/余额/固定手数等）

pros: 双平滑算法减少假信号，趋势判断更稳定
入场和出场信号独立控制，灵活性高
支持多种资金管理模式，适应不同交易风格
包含新K线检测机制，避免同根K线重复交易
提供多种通知方式（推送、邮件、警报、声音）
pros_en: Dual-smoothing algorithm reduces false signals and provides more stable trend determination
Independent control of entry and exit signals offers high flexibility
Multiple money management modes accommodate different trading styles
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading on the same bar
Multiple notification options (push, email, alert, sound) for signal awareness
cons: 依赖自定义指标SlopeDirectionLine，需要确保该指标正确加载
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，可能不适合所有品种
缺少加仓和减仓逻辑，仓位管理较为简单
未包含点差过滤，在宽点差环境下可能产生不利成交
指标值判断仅依赖0和2两个离散值，缺少中间状态处理
cons_en: Depends on the custom SlopeDirectionLine indicator, requiring correct loading and availability
Default StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are very large and may not suit all instruments
No scaling in/out logic, making position management relatively simplistic
No spread filter included, potentially leading to unfavorable fills in wide-spread environments
Indicator value judgment relies only on discrete values 0 and 2, lacking handling of intermediate states
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免不利交易环境
添加移动止损或追踪止损功能，更好地保护利润
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid unfavorable trading conditions
Implement trailing stop functionality to better protect profits during trending moves

risk_points: 默认止损1000点过大，可能导致单笔亏损较大
缺少点差过滤，在流动性差的市场可能滑点严重
依赖外部指标文件，若指标加载失败则EA无法运行
risk_points_en: Default StopLoss of 1000 points is large and may result in significant per-trade losses
No spread filter means severe slippage possible in low-liquidity markets
Dependency on external indicator file means EA fails if the indicator cannot load

It uses a double-smoothing approach with configurable smoothing methods and manages both entry and exit signals independently with separate toggle switches.
